headline: Malaysia Urges Data Centers to Cut Links With US-Blacklisted Tech Firms
summary: Malaysia urged data center operators to sever ties with seven companies, including Singapore-based Megaspeed, that were added to a US trade blacklist barring purchases of advanced chips.
why: Enforcement of US export controls by regional governments impacts technology supply chains and data center operations across Southeast Asia.

impacts.name: Malaysia
impacts.why: The directive was issued by authorities in Malaysia.
